key_insight: A2D2 unifies reward-guided fine-tuning and adaptive decoding for any-length discrete diffusion by jointly optimizing insertion and unmasking policies toward a reward-tilted sequence distribution.
engineering_relevance: It offers a practical way to improve sequence generation quality and flexibility without requiring target samples, making it relevant for controllable text and other discrete generative systems.
method: Derives a Radon-Nikodym derivative for the joint insertion-unmasking path measure.
Introduces Adaptive Joint Decoding (AJD) to jointly tune insertion and unmasking with a quality-based inference schedule.
Uses tractable insertion/unmasking quality signals to reduce decoding error and provably target the reward-tilted distribution.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports empirical improvements in reward optimization, generation flexibility, and accuracy over prior fixed-length fine-tuning and inference-time guidance methods.
watch_item: The approach depends on estimating reward-guided path qualities and implementing a joint decoding schedule, which may add tuning complexity and compute overhead.
paper_title: A2D2: Fine-Tuning Any-Length Discrete Diffusion for Adaptive Decoding
